capabilities: sync todo items from a file or the whole vault to Google Calendar events
read estimated and actual time from todo parentheses
update event descriptions with estimated-versus-actual time on completion
update or delete events when todos change or are removed
configure start time, calendar ID and time zone
disambiguation: Not a general two-way calendar client; it only pushes note todos to Google Calendar and updates their events.
extras: Desktop only (local HTTP server for OAuth); requires the user to create a Google Cloud project and OAuth credentials; sync state is stored in sync-data.json inside the plugin folder.
problem: Obsidian todos live as plain list items with no schedule, so time-estimated work never shows up on a calendar or gets compared against actual time spent.

relations.evidence: Reads todo items from your Obsidian notes and creates Google Calendar events with the correct duration.

summary: Syncs todo items with time estimates from notes to Google Calendar events and records estimated versus actual time on completion.
